items-center gap-3"> <h1 class="heading-2xl md:heading-2xl"> Time awareness and async input for personal agents </h1>  </div>  </div> <p class="mx-auto max-w-xl text-md md:text-lg text-secondary leading-relaxed">How to build agents that consider time constraints and keep working while waiting for user input</p> <div class="w-full flex justify-center"> <div class="flex w-full flex-wrap items-center gap-3 justify-center"> <p class="text-sm text-secondary"> <span class="font-medium text-default">Author:</span>  Kevin Whinnery </p>   </div> </div> </header> <div class="flex justify-center h-[300px] bg-gradient-to-b from-black/70 to-black/20 rounded-lg" style="height: auto; aspect-ratio: 2048 / 768"> <picture class="block h-full w-full">  <img src="/images/blog/putting-your-agent-on-the-clock/cover.webp" alt="Time awareness and async input for personal agents" width="2048" height="768" class="block w-full h-full object-cover rounded-lg"> </picture> </div> </div> <article id="mainContent" class="prose prose-content blog-prose-content dark:prose-invert max-w-none pt-4 pb-0">   <p>If you’re building a personal agent <a href="https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/dots" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">similar to a dot</a>, you’ll often want to deliver results to the user on a deadline.</p>
<p>Let’s say I have a meeting with a prospective customer in 15 minutes. I ask my agent to research the company and prepare a briefing, leaving me three minutes to read it before the meeting. That’s a pretty typical timeline for my meeting prep during the workday 😬.</p>
<p>The agent notices that I haven’t said whether the meeting is a technical evaluation or a discussion about pricing. That distinction would change which details to investigate and what content to include in the briefing.</p>
<p>The agent decides to ask about the meeting’s focus. While waiting for my reply, how should the agent use the remaining time, incorporate a reply if one arrives, and deliver a useful briefing even if I never answer?</p>
<h2 id="time-awareness-and-async-input">Time awareness and async input</h2>
<p><strong>Time awareness</strong>, a recent addition to the <a href="/api/docs/guides/agents-api/overview">Agents API</a>, gives the model periodic reminders of the current time so it can adjust its work to the deadline. <strong><a href="/api/docs/guides/async-tool-calling#how-async-tools-work">Async function tools</a></strong> let the agent continue working while the application waits for an answer from the end user.</p>
<p>With 15 minutes until the meeting, the agent has 12 minutes to prepare my briefing. As that deadline approaches, the agent can prioritize checking its strongest findings and writing the briefing over opening another line of research. Alternatively, providing longer timelines lets the model know it can afford to go deeper and perform more research.</p>
<p>A request like “I have a meeting in 15 minutes. Give me a briefing with three minutes left to review it” sets the deadline. Time awareness keeps the model informed as searches and user input are pending.</p>
<div class="contents" data-markdown-export="illustration" data-markdown-description="The agent researches Pied Piper while asking whether the meeting is technical or commercial. A reply focuses the briefing. At 4:10 an unanswered question expires and the agent writes for both meeting goals. <p>To show how this works, we’ll set up an agent to help users prepare for meetings. In the illustration, I ask at 4 p.m. UTC for a briefing by 4:12 p.m., ahead of a 4:15 p.m. meeting. We’ll see how to configure the agent, provide timing updates, react to its tool calls, and handle its final result.</p>
<p>You can <a href="#complete-example-code">skip right to the full example code for your preferred programming language</a>.</p>
<h2 id="create-the-agent">Create the agent</h2>
<p>To help the user prep for a meeting, our agent needs to research the company, ask for missing meeting context, and track the time left to prepare a briefing. To perform those tasks, the agent will need web search, an asynchronous tool to ask for user input, and time awareness.</p>
<p>We create an agent <a href="/api/docs/guides/agents-api/configuration">with this configuration</a> using the SDK’s <a href="/api/reference/resources/beta/subresources/agents/methods/create">agent creation method</a>:</p>
<ul>
<li>Set <code>experimental.time_awareness</code> to <code>true</code> to give the model periodic reminders of the current time.</li>
<li>Enable the built-in <a href="/api/docs/guides/agents-api/tools/web-search"><code>web_search</code> tool</a> in <code>live</code> mode so the agent can search the web for current information.</li>
<li>Define a <a href="/api/docs/guides/agents-api/tools/functions">function tool</a> named <code>request_user_input_async</code>. Set <code>async</code> to <code>true</code> so the agent can continue working while your application collects the reply.</li>
</ul>
<p>Set <code>OPENAI_API_KEY</code> to a key from a project with Agents API access. Follow the <a href="/api/docs/libraries">SDK libraries guide</a> to install an official SDK and create the <code>client</code> used below. See the <a href="/api/docs/guides/agents-api/quickstart#prerequisites">Agents API quickstart prerequisites</a> for required permissions.</p>
<astro-island uid="1UNy4w" prefix="r16" component-url="/_astro/CodeSample.react.DD8CPsTS.js?dpl=dpl_HqmkDGHzk5whr4wXhQEu8geA2iCc" component-export="CodeSample" renderer-url="/_astro/client.DvWPd3sc.js?dpl=dpl_HqmkDGHzk5whr4wXhQEu8geA2iCc" props="{&quot;title&quot;:[0,&quot;Create the meeting preparation agent&quot;],&quot;defaultLanguage&quot;:[0,&quot;python&quot;],&quot;code&quot;:[0,{&quot;typescript&quot;:[0,&quot;const requests = new AbortController();\n\nconst agent = await client.beta.agents.create(\n  {\n    name: \&quot;Personal assistant\&quot;,\n    model: \&quot;gpt-6.2-astra\&quot;,\n    instructions:\n      \&quot;You are a personal assistant. Deliver useful, well-sourced answers within the user&#39;s time constraints. \&quot; +\n      \&quot;Ask for clarification when it would materially improve the result, and keep making progress while a reply is pending. \&quot; +\n      \&quot;State important uncertainties.\&quot;,\n    experimental: { time_awareness: true },\n    tools: [\n      { type: \&quot;web_search\&quot;, mode: \&quot;live\&quot; },\n      {\n        type: \&quot;function\&quot;,\n        name: \&quot;request_user_input_async\&quot;,\n        description:\n          \&quot;Ask the user for context. The result contains their reply or reports that the question expired.\&quot;,\n        async: true,\n        parameters: {\n          type: \&quot;object\&quot;,\n          properties: {\n            question: { type: \&quot;string\&quot; },\n            choices: {\n              type: \&quot;array\&quot;,\n              items: { type: \&quot;string\&quot; },\n              description:\n                \&quot;Optional suggested replies to display with the question.\&quot;,\n            },\n          },\n          required: [\&quot;question\&quot;],\n          additionalProperties: false,\n        },\n      },\n    ],\n  },\n  { signal: requests.signal }\n);&quot;],&quot;python&quot;:[0,&quot;async def create_agent(client: AsyncOpenAI):\n    return await client.beta.agents.create(\n        name=\&quot;Personal assistant\&quot;,\n        model=\&quot;gpt-6.2-astra\&quot;,\n        experimental={\&quot;time_awareness\&quot;: True},\n        instructions=(\n            \&quot;You are a personal assistant. <h2 id="start-a-task-with-a-deadline">Start a task with a deadline</h2>
<p>Now we can ask the agent to prepare for a meeting with a customer. The request gives the agent the company, the meeting time, and the briefing deadline, leaving it to decide what to research and whether to ask for clarification.</p>
<p>Start a <a href="/api/docs/guides/agents-api/sessions">session</a> with the SDK’s <a href="/api/reference/resources/beta/subresources/agents/subresources/sessions/methods/create">session creation method</a> and stream updates as the agent works.</p>
<p>Your application will need to convert time-based language like “in 15 minutes” and “three minutes left to review” into absolute timestamps so the model and application share the same time data. This code tells the agent the meeting is 15 minutes from now and asks for delivery 12 minutes from now.</p>
<astro-island uid="1thxO6" prefix="r17" component-url="/_astro/CodeSample.react.DD8CPsTS.js?dpl=dpl_HqmkDGHzk5whr4wXhQEu8geA2iCc" component-export="CodeSample" renderer-url="/_astro/client.DvWPd3sc.js?dpl=dpl_HqmkDGHzk5whr4wXhQEu8geA2iCc" props="{&quot;title&quot;:[0,&quot;Start the meeting preparation session&quot;],&quot;defaultLanguage&quot;:[0,&quot;python&quot;],&quot;code&quot;:[0,{&quot;typescript&quot;:[0,&quot;const startedAt = Date.now();\nconst meetingAt = new Date(startedAt + 15 * 60_000);\nconst briefingBy = new Date(startedAt + 12 * 60_000);\nconst replyCutoff = new Date(startedAt + 10 * 60_000);\n\nconst stream = await client.beta.agents.sessions.create(\n  {\n    agent_id: agent.id,\n    environment: { type: \&quot;none\&quot; },\n    stream: true,\n    input:\n      `I am meeting with Pied Piper (example.com) about our customer-support software at ${meetingAt.toISOString()}. ` +\n      \&quot;Get me up to speed on their business, recent product announcements, and questions I should ask. \&quot; +\n      `Send me a concise briefing by ${briefingBy.toISOString()} so I have time to read it before the meeting.`,\n  },\n  { signal: requests.signal }\n);&quot;],&quot;python&quot;:[0,&quot;now = datetime.now(UTC)\nmeeting = (now + timedelta(minutes=15)).isoformat(timespec=\&quot;seconds\&quot;)\ndelivery = (now + timedelta(minutes=12)).isoformat(timespec=\&quot;seconds\&quot;)\nstream = await client.beta.agents.sessions.create(\n    agent_id=agent.id,\n    environment={\&quot;type\&quot;: \&quot;none\&quot;},\n    input=(\n        f\&quot;I am meeting with Pied Piper (example.com) about our customer-support software at \&quot;\n        f\&quot;{meeting}. Get me up to speed on their business, recent product \&quot;\n        f\&quot;announcements, and questions I should ask. <h2 id="display-a-pending-question">Display a pending question</h2>
<p>When the agent asks about the meeting’s focus, the application needs to show the question while company research continues. Collecting a reply in a separate task lets the application keep receiving the agent’s updates.</p>
<p>It’s up to your application code to collect user input for clarification when the model asks for it via a tool call.</p>
<p>Watch the <a href="/api/docs/guides/agents-api/sessions/events">session event stream</a> for <a href="/api/reference/resources/beta/subresources/agents/streaming-events"><code>agent.session.turn.item.done</code></a> events containing a <code>request_user_input_async</code> function call. Read the question and any suggested choices from <code>item.arguments</code>. The session’s <code>required_actions</code> list describes blocking actions, so waiting for an entry there can miss an asynchronous question.</p>
<p>Save the session ID and the call’s <code>turn_id</code> and <code>call_id</code> to associate the reply with the question. Track pending questions so each is displayed and handled once, and cancel their input handlers when the agent’s run ends:</p>

<h2 id="return-the-tool-result">Return the tool result</h2>
<p>The user’s answer to the agent’s question helps the agent focus the briefing on the right meeting goal. If the user never answers, the agent still needs time to finish writing, so the application closes unanswered questions at 4:10 p.m., two minutes before delivery.</p>
<p>Return one <a href="/api/docs/guides/agents-api/tools/functions#return-the-result">tool result</a> per pending call while the agent’s run is active:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>On reply</strong>, set <code>status</code> to <code>answered</code> and put the typed text or selected choice in <code>answer</code>.</li>
<li><strong>At the cutoff</strong>, if the same <code>call_id</code> is still pending and the user has not replied, return <code>{&quot;status&quot;:&quot;no_answer&quot;}</code>.</li>
</ul>
<p>Send the result through the SDK’s <a href="/api/reference/resources/beta/subresources/agents/subresources/sessions/subresources/events/methods/create">session events method</a>, using the saved identifiers to match it to the question. Keep consuming the stream while submitting the result. If the agent finishes early, close the pending question in the interface.</p>

<h2 id="retrieve-and-deliver-the-answer">Retrieve and deliver the answer</h2>
<p>Deliver a concise briefing as soon as it is ready, leaving the user at least three minutes to read it before the meeting. If the deadline arrives first, return the latest completed briefing or report that no verified findings are ready.</p>
<p>When <code>agent.session.turn.completed</code> arrives, retrieve the saved <a href="/api/docs/guides/agents-api/sessions/events#fetch-items-and-turns">items</a> with the SDK’s <a href="/api/reference/resources/beta/subresources/agents/subresources/sessions/subresources/turns/subresources/items/methods/list">turn items method</a>. Find the completed agent message whose <code>phase</code> is <code>final_answer</code>.</p>
<p>If the stream closes early, <a href="/api/reference/resources/beta/subresources/agents/subresources/sessions/subresources/turns/methods/list">list the session’s turns</a> to check the saved status. See <a href="/api/docs/guides/agents-api/sessions/events#how-to-recover-a-disconnected-stream">stream recovery</a> for reconnecting and retrieving saved work.</p>

{\n  const waiting = waitingReplies.values().next().value;\n  if (waiting) {\n    waiting(\n      Date.now() &lt; replyCutoff.getTime() ? line.trim() || undefined : undefined\n    );\n  } else bufferedReplies.push(line.trim());\n});\n\nfunction closeQuestions() {\n  for (const finish of waitingReplies.values()) finish();\n  terminal.close();\n  process.stdin.pause();\n}\n\nfunction deliver(text: string) {\n  if (delivered) return;\n  delivered = true;\n  console.log(text);\n}\n\nfunction readReply(call: AgentFunctionCallItem): Promise&lt;string | undefined&gt; {\n  return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {\n    const key = `${call.turn_id}:${call.call_id}`;\n    let timer: ReturnType&lt;typeof setTimeout&gt; | undefined;\n    const finish = (answer?: string) =&gt; {\n      clearTimeout(timer);\n      waitingReplies.delete(key);\n      resolve(answer);\n    };\n    waitingReplies.set(key, finish);\n    timer = setTimeout(finish, Math.max(0, replyCutoff.getTime() - Date.now()));\n    if (Date.now() &gt;= replyCutoff.getTime()) finish();\n    else if (bufferedReplies.length)\n      finish(bufferedReplies.shift() || undefined);\n  });\n}\n\nasync function returnResult(\n  sessionId: string,\n  call: AgentFunctionCallItem,\n  answer: string | undefined\n) {\n  const result = answer\n    ? { status: \&quot;answered\&quot;, answer }\n    : { status: \&quot;no_answer\&quot; };\n  await client.beta.agents.sessions.events.create(\n    sessionId,\n    {\n      events: [\n        {\n          type: \&quot;agent.session.input.tool_result\&quot;,\n          turn_id: call.turn_id,\n          call_id: call.call_id,\n          success: true,\n          output: JSON.stringify(result),\n        },\n      ],\n    },\n    { signal: requests.signal }\n  );\n}\n\nasync function collectReply(sessionId: string, call: AgentFunctionCallItem) {\n  const arguments_ = call.arguments;\n  if (\n    typeof arguments_ !== \&quot;object\&quot; ||\n    arguments_ === null ||\n    !(\&quot;question\&quot; in arguments_) ||\n    typeof arguments_.question !== \&quot;string\&quot;\n  ) {\n    throw new Error(\&quot;The question tool did not provide a question\&quot;);\n  }\n  console.error(arguments_.question);\n  if (\&quot;choices\&quot; in arguments_ &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(arguments_.choices)) {\n    console.error(arguments_.choices.join(\&quot; / \&quot;));\n  }\n  const answer = await readReply(call);\n  if (turnActive &amp;&amp; {\n              replyError = error;\n              requests.abort();\n            }\n          );\n          replyTasks.add(task);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    if (\n      event.type === \&quot;agent.session.turn.item.done\&quot; part.text).join(\&quot;\\n\&quot;);\n    }\n    if (event.type === \&quot;agent.session.turn.completed\&quot;) {\n      turnActive = false;\n      closeQuestions();\n      finalAnswer = await retrieveAnswer(event.session_id, event.turn.id);\n      deliver(finalAnswer);\n      break;\n    }\n    if (\n      event.type === \&quot;agent.session.turn.failed\&quot; }],\n          });\n        }\n      } finally {\n        // Cancellation can briefly leave the session busy.\n        await client.beta.agents.sessions.delete(sessionId, {\n          maxRetries: 5,\n          timeout: 10_000,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n  } finally {\n    if (agentId) await client.beta.agents.delete(agentId);\n  }\n}\n&quot;],&quot;python&quot;:[0,&quot;import asyncio\nimport json\nimport os\nimport sys\nfrom contextlib import AsyncExitStack, suppress\nfrom datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta\nfrom threading import Thread\n\nfrom openai import AsyncOpenAI, ConflictError\nfrom openai.types.beta import AgentFunctionCallItem, AgentOutputItem, AgentSessionItem\n\nclient = AsyncOpenAI(max_retries=0)\n\n\nasync def create_agent(client: AsyncOpenAI):\n    return await client.beta.agents.create(\n        name=\&quot;Personal assistant\&quot;,\n        model=\&quot;gpt-6.2-astra\&quot;,\n        experimental={\&quot;time_awareness\&quot;: True},\n        instructions=(\n            \&quot;You are a personal assistant. asyncio.Queue[str]:\n    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()\n    replies: asyncio.Queue[str] = asyncio.Queue()\n\n    def read_lines():\n        with os.fdopen(\n            os.dup(sys.stdin.fileno()), encoding=sys.stdin.encoding\n        ) as terminal:\n            for line in terminal:\n                try:\n                    loop.call_soon_threadsafe(replies.put_nowait, line.strip())\n                except RuntimeError:\n                    return  # The session and its event loop have closed.\n\n    # A pending terminal read must not keep the program open after delivery.\n    Thread(target=read_lines, daemon=True).start()\n    return replies\n\n\nasync def respond(client, session_id, call, replies, prompt_lock, cutoff):\n    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()\n    try:\n        async with asyncio.timeout_at(cutoff), prompt_lock:\n            if loop.time() &gt;= cutoff:\n                raise TimeoutError\n            print(call.arguments[\&quot;question\&quot;], file=sys.stderr, flush=True)\n            for choice in call.arguments.get(\&quot;choices\&quot;, []):\n                print(f\&quot; iterator.hasNext()) {\n          var event = iterator.next();\n          event.created().ifPresent(created -&gt; sessionId = created.session().id());\n          if (event.turnItemDone().isPresent()) {\n            var item = event.turnItemDone().get().item();\n            if (item.functionCall().isPresent()) {\n              var call = item.functionCall().get();\n              String key = call.turnId() + \&quot;:\&quot; + call.callId();\n              if (call.name().equals(\&quot;request_user_input_async\&quot;) &amp;&amp; seenCalls.add(key)) {\n                // Collect the reply on another thread while consuming session events.\n                replyWorker.submit(\n                    () -&gt; collectReply(event.turnItemDone().get().sessionId(), call));\n              }\n            }\n          }\n          event\n              .turnItemDone()\n              .flatMap(done -&gt; done.item().message())\n              .filter(message -&gt; message.status().toString().equals(\&quot;completed\&quot;))\n              .filter(\n                  message -&gt;\n                      message\n                          .phase()\n                          .map(phase -&gt; phase.toString().equals(\&quot;final_answer\&quot;))\n                          .orElse(false))\n              .ifPresent(\n                  message -&gt;\n                      finalAnswer =\n                          message.content().stream()\n                              .map(part -&gt; part.text())\n                              .collect(Collectors.joining(\&quot;\\n\&quot;)));\n          if (event.turnCompleted().isPresent()) {\n            active.set(false);\n            replyWorker.shutdownNow();\n            var completed = event.turnCompleted().get();\n            finalAnswer = retrieveAnswer(completed.sessionId(), completed.turn().id());\n            deliver(finalAnswer);\n            break;\n          }\n          if (event.turnFailed().isPresent()\n              || event.turnCancelled().isPresent()\n              || event.failed().isPresent()\n              || event.environmentFailed().isPresent()\n              || event.error().isPresent()) {\n            throw new IllegalStateException(\&quot;Agent lifecycle failure: \&quot; retry a temporary deletion conflict.\n            client\n                .withOptions(options -&gt; options.maxRetries(5).timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(10)))\n                .beta()\n                .agents()\n                .sessions()\n                .delete(sessionId);\n          }\n        }\n      } finally {\n        if (agentId != null) client.beta().agents().delete(agentId);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  private void collectReply(String sessionId, AgentFunctionCallItem call) {\n    try {\n      var question = call._arguments().convert(Question.class);\n      System.err.println(question.question());\n      if (question.choices() != null) System.err.println(String.join(\&quot; / \&quot;, question.choices()));\n      long remaining = Math.max(0, Duration.between(Instant.now(), replyCutoff).toMillis());\n      String answer = remaining == 0 ? null : replies.poll(remaining, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);\n      if (Instant.now().isAfter(replyCutoff)) answer = null;\n      if (active.get() &amp;&amp; !expired.get()) returnResult(sessionId, call, answer);\n    } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {\n      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();\n    } catch (Exception error) {\n      if (active.get() &amp;&amp; !expired.get()) {\n        replyError.set(new IllegalStateException(\&quot;Could not return the reply\&quot;, error));\n        closeStream();\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  private void returnResult(String sessionId, AgentFunctionCallItem call, String answer)\n      throws Exception {\n    var result =\n        answer == null || answer.isBlank()\n            ? Map.of(\&quot;status\&quot;, \&quot;no_answer\&quot;)\n            : Map.of(\&quot;status\&quot;, \&quot;answered\&quot;, \&quot;answer\&quot;, answer);\n    client\n        .beta()\n        .agents()\n        .sessions()\n        .events()\n        .create(\n            EventCreateParams.builder()\n                .sessionId(sessionId)\n                .addEvent(\n                    AgentSessionInputParam.AgentSessionInputToolResult.builder()\n                        .turnId(call.turnId())\n                        .callId(call.callId())\n                        .success(true)\n                        .output(new JsonMapper().writeValueAsString(result))\n                        .build())\n                .build());\n  }\n\n\n  private String retrieveAnswer(String sessionId, String turnId) {\n    var items =\n        client\n            .beta()\n            .agents()\n            .sessions()\n            .turns()\n            .items()\n            .list(\n                ItemListParams.builder()\n                    .sessionId(sessionId)\n                    .turnId(turnId)\n                    .order(ItemListParams.Order.DESC)\n                    .build());\n    for (var item : items.autoPager()) {\n      if (item.message().isEmpty()) continue;\n      var message = item.message().get();\n      if (message.role().toString().equals(\&quot;assistant\&quot;)\n          &amp;&amp; message.status().toString().equals(\&quot;completed\&quot;)\n          &amp;&amp; message.phase().map(phase -&gt; phase.toString().equals(\&quot;final_answer\&quot;)).orElse(false)) {\n        return message.content().stream()\n            .flatMap(part -&gt; {\n              try {\n                var reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));\n                String line;\n                while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) replies.add(line.trim());\n              } catch (java.io.IOException error) {\n                System.err.println(\&quot;Input closed: \&quot; State important uncertainties.\&quot;,\n    tools: [\n      {\n        type: \&quot;web_search\&quot;,\n        mode: \&quot;live\&quot;\n      },\n      {\n        type: \&quot;function\&quot;,\n        name: \&quot;request_user_input_async\&quot;,\n        description: \&quot;Ask for missing context while continuing independent work.\&quot;,\n        async: true,\n        parameters: {\n          type: \&quot;object\&quot;,\n          properties: {\n            question: { type: \&quot;string\&quot; },\n            choices: {\n              type: \&quot;array\&quot;,\n              items: { type: \&quot;string\&quot; }\n            }\n          },\n          required: [\&quot;question\&quot;],\n          additionalProperties: false\n        }\n      }\n    ]\n  )\nend\n\ndef monotonic_time\n  Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC)\nend\n\ndef console_reply(arguments, input_lock, cutoff)\n  remaining = cutoff - monotonic_time\n  return if remaining &lt;= 0\n\n  Timeout.timeout(remaining) do\n    input_lock.synchronize do\n      return if monotonic_time &gt;= cutoff\n\n      question = arguments.transform_keys(&amp;:to_s)\n      warn question.fetch(\&quot;question\&quot;)\n      Array(question[\&quot;choices\&quot;]).each { |choice| warn \&quot;  #{choice}\&quot; }\n      line = $stdin.gets\n      sleep([cutoff - monotonic_time, 0].max) if line.nil?\n      line&amp;.strip if monotonic_time &lt; cutoff\n    end\n  end\nrescue Timeout::Error\n  nil\nend\n\ndef return_result(sessions, session_id, call, answer)\n  result = if answer.nil? || answer.empty?\n             { status: \&quot;no_answer\&quot; }\n           else\n             {\n               status: \&quot;answered\&quot;,\n               answer: answer\n             }\n           end\n  sessions.events.create(\n    session_id,\n    events: [\n      {\n        type: \&quot;agent.session.input.tool_result\&quot;,\n        turn_id: call.turn_id,\n        call_id: call.call_id,\n        success: true,\n        output: JSON.generate(result)\n      }\n    ]\n  )\nend\n\ndef final_text(item)\n  return unless item.type.to_s == \&quot;message\&quot; &amp;&amp; item.role.to_s == \&quot;assistant\&quot; &amp;&amp;\n                item.status.to_s == \&quot;completed\&quot; &amp;&amp; item.phase.to_s == \&quot;final_answer\&quot;\n\n  text = item.content.select { |part| part.type.to_s == \&quot;output_text\&quot; }.map(&amp;:text).join(\&quot;\\n\&quot;)\n  text unless text.empty?\nend\n\ndef retrieve_answer(sessions, session_id, turn_id)\n  page = sessions.turns.items.list(turn_id, session_id: session_id, order: \&quot;desc\&quot;)\n  page.auto_paging_each do |item|\n    text = final_text(item)\n    return text if text &amp;&amp; !text.empty?\n  end\n  nil\nend\n\ndef prepare_briefing(client, agent_id)\n  sessions = client.beta.agents.sessions\n  state = {\n    session_id: nil,\n    stream: nil,\n    status: nil,\n    answer: nil\n  }\n  questions = {}\n  input_lock = Mutex.new\n  cutoff = monotonic_time + 10 * 60\n\n  begin\n    Timeout.timeout(12 * 60) do\n      now = Time.now.utc\n      meeting = (now + 15 * 60).iso8601\n      delivery = (now + 12 * 60).iso8601\n      stream = sessions.create_streaming(\n        agent_id: agent_id,\n        environment: { type: \&quot;none\&quot; },\n        input: \&quot;I am meeting with Pied Piper (example.com) about our customer-support software \&quot; \\\n          \&quot;at #{meeting}. Send me a concise briefing \&quot; \\\n          \&quot;by #{delivery} so I have time to read it before the meeting.\&quot;\n      )\n      state[:stream] = stream\n      stream.each do |event|\n        questions.each_value { |thread| thread.value unless thread.alive? }\n        case event\n        when OpenAI::Models::Beta::AgentSessionCreatedEvent\n          state[:session_id] = questions[item.call_id] = Thread.new(item, event.session_id) do |call, id|\n              answer = console_reply(call.arguments, input_lock, cutoff)\n              return_result(sessions, id, call, answer)\n            rescue OpenAI::Errors::ConflictError\n              # The turn can finish while the reply is in flight.\n              nil\n            end\n          end\n          state[:answer] = final_text(item) || state[:answer]\n        when OpenAI::Models::Beta::AgentSessionTurnCompletedEvent\n          state[:status] = :completed\n          questions.each_value(&amp;:kill)\n          state[:answer] = retrieve_answer(sessions, event.session_id, event.turn.id) || state[:answer]\n          break\n        when OpenAI::Models::Beta::AgentSessionTurnFailedEvent,\n            OpenAI::Models::Beta::AgentSessionTurnCancelledEvent,\n            OpenAI::Models::Beta::AgentSessionFailedEvent,\n            OpenAI::Models::Beta::AgentSessionEnvironmentFailedEvent\n          state[:status] = :failed\n          raise \&quot;Meeting briefing stopped: #{event.type}\&quot;\n        when OpenAI::Models::Beta::AgentSessionErrorEvent\n          raise \&quot;Meeting briefing stopped: #{event.type}\&quot;\n        end\n      end\n      raise \&quot;The event stream closed before the turn completed.\&quot; unless state[:status] == :completed\n    end\n    puts(state[:answer] || \&quot;No verified findings were available.\&quot;)\n  rescue Timeout::Error\n    puts(state[:answer] || \&quot;No verified findings were available by the deadline.\&quot;)\n  ensure\n    $stdout.flush\n    questions.each_value(&amp;:kill)\n    begin\n      state[:stream]&amp;.close\n      session_id = state[:session_id]\n      sessions.events.create(session_id, events: [{ type: \&quot;agent.session.input.cancel\&quot; }]) if state[:status] == :active &amp;&amp; session_id\n    ensure\n      if state[:session_id]\n        # Cancellation settles asynchronously; retry a temporary deletion conflict.\n        sessions.delete(\n          state[:session_id],\n          request_options: {\n </span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line-number">276</span></span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">import OpenAI from &quot;openai&quot;;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">import type { AgentFunctionCallItem } from &quot;openai/resources/beta/agents/agents&quot;;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">import { createInterface } from &quot;node:readline&quot;;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">const client = new OpenAI({ timeout: 30_000, maxRetries: 0 });</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">const startedAt = Date.now();</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">const meetingAt = new Date(startedAt + 15 * 60_000);</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">const briefingBy = new Date(startedAt + 12 * 60_000);</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">const replyCutoff = new Date(startedAt + 10 * 60_000);</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">const requests = new AbortController();</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">const terminal = createInterface({ input: process.stdin });</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">const bufferedReplies: string[] = [];</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">const waitingReplies = new Map&lt;string, (answer?: string) =&gt; void&gt;();</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">const seenCalls = new Set&lt;string&gt;();</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">const replyTasks = new Set&lt;Promise&lt;void&gt;&gt;();</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">let agentId: string | undefined;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">let sessionId: string | undefined;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">let turnActive = false;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">let delivered = false;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">let deadlineReached = false;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">let finalAnswer = &quot;&quot;;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">let replyError: unknown;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">terminal.on(&quot;line&quot;, (line) =&gt; {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  const waiting = waitingReplies.values().next().value;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  if (waiting) {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    waiting(</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      Date.now() &lt; replyCutoff.getTime() ? line.trim() || undefined : undefined</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    );</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  } else bufferedReplies.push(line.trim());</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">});</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">function closeQuestions() {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  for (const finish of waitingReplies.values()) finish();</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  terminal.close();</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  process.stdin.pause();</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">function deliver(text: string) {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  if (delivered) return;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  delivered = true;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  console.log(text);</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">function readReply(call: AgentFunctionCallItem): Promise&lt;string | undefined&gt; {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    const key = `${call.turn_id}:${call.call_id}`;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    let timer: ReturnType&lt;typeof setTimeout&gt; | undefined;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    const finish = (answer?: string) =&gt; {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      clearTimeout(timer);</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      waitingReplies.delete(key);</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      resolve(answer);</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    };</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    waitingReplies.set(key, finish);</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    timer = setTimeout(finish, Math.max(0, replyCutoff.getTime() - Date.now()));</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    if (Date.now() &gt;= replyCutoff.getTime()) finish();</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    else if (bufferedReplies.length)</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">async function returnResult(</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  turnActive = true;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  for await (const event of stream) {</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">func retrieveAnswer(ctx context.Context, client *openai.Client, sessionID, turnID string) (string, error) {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	items := client.Beta.Agents.Sessions.Turns.Items.ListAutoPaging(ctx, sessionID, turnID,</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	}</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">func consoleReplies(ctx context.Context) &lt;-chan string {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	lines := make(chan string)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	go func() {</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	}()</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	return lines</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">func (q *question) show() error {</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">func run() (err error) {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	started := time.Now()</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	replyCutoff := started.Add(10 * time.Minute)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	briefingBy := started.Add(12 * time.Minute)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	meetingAt := started.Add(15 * time.Minute)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	ctx, cancel := context.WithDeadline(context.Background(), briefingBy)</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		AgentID:     openai.String(agent.ID),</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		Environment: openai.EnvironmentParamUnion{OfParamNone: &amp;openai.EnvironmentParamNone{}},</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		Input: openai.BetaAgentSessionNewParamsInputUnion{OfString: openai.String(fmt.Sprintf(</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			&quot;I am meeting with Pied Piper (example.com) about our customer-support software at %s. &quot;+</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				&quot;Get me up to speed on their business, recent product announcements, and questions I should ask. &quot;+</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				&quot;Send me a concise briefing by %s so I have time to read it before the meeting.&quot;,</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			meetingAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339), briefingBy.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)))},</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	})</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	incoming := make(chan openai.AgentSessionEventUnion)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	readerDone := make(chan struct{})</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	go func() {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		defer close(readerDone)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		defer close(incoming)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		defer events.Close()</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		for events.Next() {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			select {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			case incoming &lt;- events.Current():</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			case &lt;-streamCtx.Done():</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				return</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	}()</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	defer func() {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		stopStream()</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		&lt;-readerDone</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	}()</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	lines := consoleReplies(ctx)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	cutoffTimer := time.NewTimer(time.Until(replyCutoff))</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	defer cutoffTimer.Stop()</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	seen := map[string]bool{}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	var pending []question</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	for {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		var reply &lt;-chan string</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		if len(pending) != 0 {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			if !time.Now().Before(replyCutoff) || lines == nil {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				if err := returnResult(ctx, &amp;client, sessionID, pending[0].call, &quot;&quot;); err != nil {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">					return err</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				pending = pending[1:]</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				continue</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			if !pending[0].shown {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				if err := pending[0].show(); err != nil {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">					return err</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			reply = lines</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		select {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		case &lt;-ctx.Done():</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			return ctx.Err()</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		case &lt;-cutoffTimer.C:</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			continue</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		case answer, open := &lt;-reply:</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			if !open {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				lines = nil</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			if !time.Now().Before(replyCutoff) {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				answer = &quot;&quot;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			if err := returnResult(ctx, &amp;client, sessionID, pending[0].call, answer); err != nil {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				return err</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			pending = pending[1:]</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		case event, open := &lt;-incoming:</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			if !open {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				if err := events.Err(); err != nil {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">					return err</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				return errors.New(&quot;the session stream closed before the turn finished&quot;)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			switch event.Type {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			case &quot;agent.session.created&quot;:</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				sessionID, active = event.Session.ID, true</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			case &quot;agent.session.turn.item.done&quot;:</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				item := event.AsAgentSessionTurnItemDone().Item</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				if item.Type == &quot;function_call&quot; &amp;&amp; item.Name == &quot;request_user_input_async&quot; {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">					call := item.AsFunctionCall()</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">					key := call.TurnID + &quot;/&quot; + call.CallID</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">					if !seen[key] {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">						seen[key] = true</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">						pending = append(pending, question{call: call})</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">					}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				if item.Type == &quot;message&quot; &amp;&amp; item.Status == &quot;completed&quot; &amp;&amp; item.Phase == &quot;final_answer&quot; {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">					var parts []string</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">					for _, part := range item.AsMessage().Content {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">						parts = append(parts, part.Text)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">					}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">					finalText = strings.Join(parts, &quot;\n&quot;)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			case &quot;agent.session.turn.completed&quot;:</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				active = false</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				answer, err := retrieveAnswer(ctx, &amp;client, sessionID, event.Turn.ID)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				if err != nil {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">					return err</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				if answer == &quot;&quot; {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">					answer = finalText</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				if answer == &quot;&quot; {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">					return errors.New(&quot;the completed turn has no final briefing&quot;)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				fmt.Println(answer)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				delivered = true</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				return nil</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			case &quot;agent.session.turn.failed&quot;, &quot;agent.session.turn.cancelled&quot;, &quot;agent.session.failed&quot;, &quot;agent.session.environment.failed&quot;, &quot;error&quot;:</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				return fmt.Errorf(&quot;meeting briefing stopped: %s&quot;, event.Type)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">func main() {</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  private String retrieveAnswer(String sessionId, String turnId) {</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">          &amp;&amp; message.phase().map(phase -&gt; phase.toString().equals(&quot;final_answer&quot;)).orElse(false)) {</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  private void startInputReader() {</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line-number">199</span></span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">require &quot;openai&quot;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">require &quot;json&quot;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">require &quot;time&quot;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">require &quot;timeout&quot;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">def create_agent(client)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  client.beta.agents.create(</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    name: &quot;Personal assistant&quot;,</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    model: &quot;gpt-6.2-astra&quot;,</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    experimental: { time_awareness: true },</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    instructions: &quot;You are a personal assistant. Deliver useful, well-sourced answers &quot; \</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      &quot;within the user&#x27;s time constraints. Ask for clarification when it would &quot; \</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      &quot;materially improve the result, and keep making progress while a reply is &quot; \</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      &quot;pending. State important uncertainties.&quot;,</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    tools: [</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">        type: &quot;web_search&quot;,</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">        mode: &quot;live&quot;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      },</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">        type: &quot;function&quot;,</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">        name: &quot;request_user_input_async&quot;,</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">        description: &quot;Ask for missing context while continuing independent work.&quot;,</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">        async: true,</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">        parameters: {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">          type: &quot;object&quot;,</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">          properties: {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">            question: { type: &quot;string&quot; },</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">            choices: {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">              type: &quot;array&quot;,</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">              items: { type: &quot;string&quot; }</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">            }</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">          },</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">          required: [&quot;question&quot;],</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">          additionalProperties: false</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">        }</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      }</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    ]</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  )</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">end</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">def monotonic_time</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">end</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">def console_reply(arguments, input_lock, cutoff)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  remaining = cutoff - monotonic_time</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  return if remaining &lt;= 0</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  Timeout.timeout(remaining) do</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    input_lock.synchronize do</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      return if monotonic_time &gt;= cutoff</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      question = arguments.transform_keys(&amp;:to_s)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      warn question.fetch(&quot;question&quot;)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      Array(question[&quot;choices&quot;]).each { |choice| warn &quot;  #{choice}&quot; }</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      line = $stdin.gets</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      sleep([cutoff - monotonic_time, 0].max) if line.nil?</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      line&amp;.strip if monotonic_time &lt; cutoff</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    end</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  end</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">rescue Timeout::Error</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  nil</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">end</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">def return_result(sessions, session_id, call, answer)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  result = if answer.nil? || answer.empty?</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">             { status: &quot;no_answer&quot; }</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">           else</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">             {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">               status: &quot;answered&quot;,</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">               answer: answer</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">             }</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">           end</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  sessions.events.create(</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    session_id,</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    events: [</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">        type: &quot;agent.session.input.tool_result&quot;,</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">        turn_id: call.turn_id,</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">        call_id: call.call_id,</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">        success: true,</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">        output: JSON.generate(result)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      }</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    ]</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  )</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">end</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">def final_text(item)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  return unless item.type.to_s == &quot;message&quot; &amp;&amp; item.role.to_s == &quot;assistant&quot; &amp;&amp;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">                item.status.to_s == &quot;completed&quot; &amp;&amp; item.phase.to_s == &quot;final_answer&quot;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  text = item.content.select { |part| part.type.to_s == &quot;output_text&quot; }.map(&amp;:text).join(&quot;\n&quot;)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  text unless text.empty?</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">end</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">def retrieve_answer(sessions, session_id, turn_id)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  page = sessions.turns.items.list(turn_id, session_id: session_id, order: &quot;desc&quot;)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  page.auto_paging_each do |item|</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    text = final_text(item)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    return text if text &amp;&amp; !text.empty?</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  end</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  nil</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">end</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">def prepare_briefing(client, agent_id)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  sessions = client.beta.agents.sessions</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  state = {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    session_id: nil,</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    stream: nil,</span>

<h2 id="time-awareness-in-a-responses-api-loop">Time awareness in a Responses API loop</h2>
<p>If your personal agent uses a hand-coded <a href="/api/docs/guides/function-calling">Responses API loop</a>, the application needs to keep the model informed of the time left to prepare the briefing. Calculate the deadline once, then append a fresh time reminder before every model request, including requests that submit tool results.</p>
<p>The steps below implement the same meeting-preparation task. Each Responses request includes an updated time reminder for the model. An application timer runs throughout the loop so delivery still happens if a request or tool takes too long.</p>
<details><summary>1. Set the meeting and briefing deadlines</summary><p>Give the agent the company to research and the time the briefing is due. Keep the same general instructions and <a href="/api/docs/guides/async-tool-calling#add-a-tool-to-ask-the-user-for-input">async question tool</a>, so the model decides whether it needs clarification.</p><p>The meeting starts in 15 minutes, the briefing is due in 12, and the application closes unanswered questions 10 minutes after the task starts. <details><summary>2. Add the current time before every model request</summary><p>The model needs a fresh reading of the clock when it decides what to do next. Use one request helper for both the initial request and every continuation, so the clock update happens in one place.</p><p>Immediately before calling the <a href="/api/reference/resources/responses/methods/create">Responses API</a>, append the current UTC time as a <a href="/api/docs/guides/text#message-roles-and-instruction-following">developer message</a>, after the user input or tool results. Send the instructions and tools on every request. </span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line-number">62</span></span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">func consoleReplies(ctx context.Context) &lt;-chan string {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	lines := make(chan string)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	go func() {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		// Leave the channel open on EOF. The reply cutoff resolves unanswered questions.</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		for scanner.Scan() {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			select {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			case lines &lt;- strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text()):</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			case &lt;-ctx.Done():</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				return</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	}()</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	return lines</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line-number">36</span></span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">def read_answer(arguments, input_lock, cutoff)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  remaining = cutoff - Time.now</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  return if remaining &lt;= 0</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  Timeout.timeout(remaining) do</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    input_lock.synchronize do</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      return if Time.now &gt;= cutoff</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      warn arguments.fetch(&quot;question&quot;)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      Array(arguments[&quot;choices&quot;]).each { |choice| warn &quot;  #{choice}&quot; }</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      line = $stdin.gets</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      sleep([cutoff - Time.now, 0].max) if line.nil?</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      line&amp;.strip if Time.now &lt; cutoff</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    end</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  end</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">rescue Timeout::Error</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  nil</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">end</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">def start_question(call, input_lock, cutoff)</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      // Continue consuming events while the terminal waits for a reply.</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      const task = collectReply(event.item).catch((error: unknown) =&gt; {</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    }</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      const answer = event.response.output</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">        .map((part) =&gt; part.text)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">        .join(&quot;\n&quot;);</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      return answer;</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line-number">57</span></span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">func finalText(response responses.Response) string {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	var parts []string</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	for _, item := range response.Output {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		if item.Type != &quot;message&quot; {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			continue</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		message := item.AsMessage()</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		if message.Role != &quot;assistant&quot; || message.Status != &quot;completed&quot; || (message.Phase != &quot;&quot; &amp;&amp; message.Phase != &quot;final_answer&quot;) {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			continue</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		for _, part := range message.Content {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			if part.Type == &quot;output_text&quot; {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				parts = append(parts, part.Text)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	return strings.Join(parts, &quot;\n&quot;)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">type progress struct {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	latestID, savedAnswer string</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	responseIDs           map[string]bool</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">func (s *progress) consume(ctx context.Context, stream *ssestream.Stream[responses.ResponseStreamEventUnion], box *questionBox) (string, error) {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	defer stream.Close()</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">	for stream.Next() {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		event := stream.Current()</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		switch event.Type {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		case &quot;response.created&quot;:</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			s.responseIDs[event.Response.ID] = true</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		case &quot;response.output_item.done&quot;:</span>

<details><summary>5. Continue the loop with ready results</summary><p>A reply that arrives during research should inform the next version of the briefing. After each response finishes, collect any ready tool results and send them through the request helper, which adds a new time reminder. Use the latest completed response ID as <a href="/api/docs/guides/conversation-state#passing-context-from-the-previous-response"><code>previous_response_id</code></a>, even when a result belongs to a question from an earlier response.</p><p>Keep requests sequential so each builds on the latest conversation state. If the briefing is complete and no result is ready, deliver it and close pending questions. Otherwise, continue working with the updated time, without waiting for an answer.</p><astro-island uid="Z9Glmd" prefix="r26" </span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line-number">49</span></span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">func (box *questionBox) ready() (responses.ResponseInputParam, error) {</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">		select {</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">				return nil, err</span>

</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">			item := responses.ResponseInputItemParamOfFunctionCallOutput(string(output))</span>

<details><summary>6. Enforce delivery while a request is in flight</summary><p>An application timer enforces the briefing deadline, preserving the user’s review time. Apply the timer to the whole loop, including API requests and stream consumption.</p><p>At the deadline, stop the active request and deliver the saved briefing, or report that no verified findings are ready. Close pending input handlers and <a href="/api/reference/resources/responses/methods/delete">delete the stored responses</a> after delivery.</p><astro-island uid="ZvegFh" prefix="r27"
