</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line-number">37</span></span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">cleanup() {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  local exit_status=$?</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  trap - EXIT TERM</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  for pid in &quot;$stream_pid&quot; &quot;$timer_pid&quot; &quot;$reader_pid&quot;; do</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    if [ -n &quot;$pid&quot; ]; then</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      kill &quot;$pid&quot; 2&gt;/dev/null || true</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      wait &quot;$pid&quot; 2&gt;/dev/null || true</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    fi</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  done</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  while IFS= read -r response_id; do</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 10 -X DELETE \</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      &quot;https://api.openai.com/v1/responses/$response_id&quot; \</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">      -H &quot;Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY&quot; &gt;/dev/null || exit_status=1</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  done &lt; &lt;(jq -r &#x27;reverse[]&#x27; &lt;&lt;&lt;&quot;$owned&quot;)</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  rm -rf &quot;$work&quot;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  exit &quot;$exit_status&quot;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">deliver() {</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  if mkdir &quot;$work/delivered&quot; 2&gt;/dev/null; then</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    if [ -s &quot;$work/final.txt&quot; ]; then cat &quot;$work/final.txt&quot;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    else printf &#x27;%s\n&#x27; &#x27;No verified findings were available by the deadline.&#x27;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">    fi</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  fi</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">}</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line">
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">trap cleanup EXIT</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">trap &#x27;exit 0&#x27; TERM</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">(</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  sleep &quot;$((delivery_cutoff - SECONDS))&quot; &amp;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  sleep_pid=$!</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  trap &#x27;kill &quot;$sleep_pid&quot; 2&gt;/dev/null || true; wait &quot;$sleep_pid&quot; 2&gt;/dev/null || true; exit 0&#x27; TERM</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  wait &quot;$sleep_pid&quot;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  deliver</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">  kill -TERM &quot;$$&quot;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">) &amp;</span>
</span><span class="syntax-highlighter-line"><span class="shiki-token">timer_pid=$!</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div><!--astro:end--></astro-island></details>
<h2 id="conclusion">Conclusion</h2>
<p>Personal agents sometimes need to complete work by a deadline. Ideally they ask for clarification to improve the result, but even without that clarification, they still need to perform useful work.</p>
<p>We gave the agent a deadline and enabled time awareness to help it decide whether to investigate further, verify a finding, or finish writing. Async function tools let it keep researching while the user considered its question. The agent still has enough context to write a useful meeting briefing if the question goes unanswered.</p>
<p>ChatGPT and other agent harnesses use this pattern to keep working while asking the user for clarification. We hope that including time awareness in the Agents API helps you build this pattern yourself. <a href="https://x.com/OpenAIDevs">Let us know what you build</a>!</p>  </article>  </div> </div> </div>
